title: A pay cut and morale costs
hook: Two stated cases: explore the asymmetric response assumed for equal pay changes.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the asymmetric response assumed for equal pay changes affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Difference, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the asymmetric response assumed for equal pay changes in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
